run_eval_task_complexity: run eval_task_complexity.py with --template-id 00100 to compute evaluation stats for a task template
run_eval_task_complexity_force: run eval_task_complexity.py with --force flag to recompute evaluation stats even if up to date
run_eval_task_complexity_interactive: run eval_task_complexity.py with --interactive flag to print BALL-solvable task stats to stdout
run_eval_task_complexity_slurm: run eval_task_complexity.py with --log-dir to get task ID from SLURM array and checkpoint progress
run_eval_task_complexity_workers: run eval_task_complexity.py with --num-workers to set multiprocessing pool size for parallel evaluation
